Name: Elliot Inspired
Author: Amstral
Description:
An edit of Elliot´s portrait in my style based on "Bachelors Portraits Edits by Chogo", I only edited the sprites but the code is theirs. I recommend trying their mod!! :)

READ THE MOD FILE DESCRIPTION THIS TIME!!!

Btw if it doesn´t work for you I´ll upload the same version on xnb format. Let me know on the posts please.

Instructions:
1. Drop the file on the Mods folder frome the main game.
2. Done lol
